title: ICCR Atal Bihari Vajpayee General Scholarship Scheme (AY 2026-27)
provider: Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR), Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
degree_levels: Undergraduate (UG), Postgraduate (PG), Ph.D., Diploma (Languages & Performing Arts), Certificate (Languages & Performing Arts)
application_deadline: 2026-04-22 (closed for AY 2026-27; AY 2027-28 cycle expected to open ~February 2027)
eligibility_summary: Available to foreign nationals from 180+ countries. Minimum age 18 years. Maximum age 35 years for UG/PG/Certificate/Diploma (as of July 1, 2026); 40 years for Ph.D.; no upper limit for Hindi, Sanskrit, and Indian performing arts. Must apply to up to 5 ICCR-empanelled universities. English proficiency required (500-word essay or TOEFL/IELTS). Passport must be valid for at least 2 years. Excludes medical, law, and integrated courses (e.g., BA-LLB, BSc-MSc, BTech-MTech).
funding_details: Monthly stipend: ₹18,000 (UG), ₹20,000 (PG), ₹22,000 (Ph.D.), ₹25,000 (Post-Doctoral). House Rent Allowance (HRA): ₹6,500 (Grade I cities) or ₹5,500 (other cities) when hostel accommodation is unavailable. Contingent allowance: ₹7,000/year. Thesis/dissertation allowance: ₹10,000–₹12,500 (Ph.D. only). Full tuition fee and other compulsory fees (OCF) paid directly by ICCR to the university. Return economy-class airfare provided. Medical insurance (minimum ₹5 lakh coverage) required. Payments disbursed via PFMS.
duration: Course duration (up to 5 years for Ph.D. with additional 6 months for thesis defence); up to 3 weeks after semester results for course completion

title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship – Embassy Recommendation (Research Students 2027)
provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Government of Japan, administered via Embassy of Japan in India
degree_levels: Research Students (pathway to Master's and Ph.D.), Undergraduate, KOSEN (College of Technology), Specialized Training College, Japanese Studies, Young Leaders' Program, Teacher Training
funding_type: Fully funded government scholarship (tuition + stipend + airfare + insurance)
application_deadline: 2026-05-25 (Undergraduate/KOSEN/Specialized Training); 2026-05-15 (Research Students) – closed for 2027 intake. 2028 intake cycle expected to open April 2027.
eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan. Born on or after April 2, 1992 (under 35 at program start). Must hold or expect to hold a Bachelor's degree (for Research Student/Master's) or Master's degree (for Ph.D.) by April 2027. Undergraduate applicants must have completed 12+2 with minimum 70% marks (or equivalent). English/Japanese language proficiency may be assessed. Must be in good health. Not currently holding another Japanese government scholarship.
funding_details: Full tuition waiver at host university. Monthly stipend: ¥143,000–145,000 (approximately ₹85,000–87,000). Round-trip economy-class airfare to/from Japan. Japanese-language preparatory course (up to 2 years) if required. Monthly allowance for textbooks and research (¥100,000). Academic travel allowance.
duration: 1-2 years (Research Student non-regular phase); standard period of intended Master's/Ph.D. course thereafter. Total up to 5 years. Scholarship period ends March 2029 for 2027 intake.

title: Ramanujan Fellowship (AY 2026-27)
provider: Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), Government of India (formerly Science and Engineering Research Board, SERB, DST)
degree_levels: Postdoctoral/Research (Ph.D. holders in Science, Engineering, Technology, Medicine)
funding_type: Fully funded research fellowship (consolidated stipend + research grant + overhead)
application_opening_date: Rolling – applications accepted throughout the year
eligibility_summary: Open to brilliant Indian/Indian-origin scientists and engineers working abroad (not holding any permanent/tenure-track/contractual position in India) who wish to return to India. Applicants must be below 40 years of age (as of date of nomination). Must possess a Ph.D./Mastery's in Engineering or Technology/MD or equivalent with adequate professional experience. Must have a proven outstanding track record of research publications and recognitions. Must work at an S&T institution in India other than the one where the Ph.D. was pursued. Currently working abroad at the time of nomination.
funding_details: Fellowship: ₹135,000 per month (consolidated, including HRA component). Research grant: ₹700,000 per annum (for consumables, travel, research personnel, contingencies). Overhead charges: ₹60,000 per annum to host institution. Fellowship and research grant released annually. Total funding capped at 60 months (5 years) from date of commencement.
duration: 5 years (non-extendable); must join host institute within 6 months of award letter issuance
